title: Ledgerly: the invoice that chases itself

product.name: Ledgerly
product.one_liner: invoicing for freelancers with automatic, polite payment reminders

audience: freelancers and small agencies who hate sending 'just following up' emails

presenter.description: fictional woman, late thirties, home office, cardigan; generated, not based on anyone

hook.text: You don't need to chase that invoice.
hook.why: Removes the dreaded task in the first line; the viewer wants to know how.

style: home-office phone footage, laptop glow plus window light, unpolished

shots.visual: Presenter closes a half-written 'just following up' email on her laptop
shots.caption:
you don't need to chase that invoice
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: You don't need to chase that invoice.

prompt.subject: fictional woman in her late thirties in a cardigan at a desk, closing a laptop lid halfway while looking at the lens
prompt.action: she pushes the laptop lid down and turns to the camera
prompt.lighting: window light from the left, laptop glow on her face

shots.visual: Presenter to camera, counting on fingers the three reminder emails she would normally write
shots.caption: three awkward emails per late invoice
shots.voiceover: Every late invoice means three awkward emails, and you still sound like you're begging for your own money.

prompt.subject: the same fictional woman talking to the camera, counting on three fingers
prompt.action: she raises one, two, three fingers and grimaces on the third

shots.visual: Screen recording: create an invoice, toggle 'reminders', pick a tone (friendly / firm), send
shots.caption: toggle reminders. pick a tone. send.
shots.voiceover: Send the invoice, switch reminders on, pick friendly or firm. It emails the client on day seven, fourteen and twenty-one.

shots.visual: Screen recording: the reminder email preview, written in plain language with the invoice attached
shots.caption: this is what the client gets
shots.voiceover: This is what the client gets. Plain, polite, invoice attached, pay button on top.

shots.visual: Presenter holds the phone up: a 'paid' notification, then puts the phone face down and goes back to work
shots.caption: you find out when it's paid. that's it.
shots.voiceover: You find out when it's paid. You never write the email.

prompt.subject: the fictional woman holding a phone toward the lens, a green notification banner on the screen, then placing it face down
prompt.action: she shows the phone, places it face down on the desk and turns back to her laptop

shots.visual: Presenter to camera, laptop open again
shots.caption: free for your first five invoices. link below.
shots.voiceover: Free for your first five invoices. Link below.

prompt.subject: the fictional woman at her desk, laptop open, speaking to the camera
prompt.action: she nods toward the bottom of the frame

claims.evidence: default reminder schedule in the product settings; screenshot in the campaign folder with the date

claims.text: free for your first five invoices
claims.evidence: pricing page, free tier limit; checked on the filming date
